title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Are you guys announcing anything else other than “potential” non-tenders tonight
We don’t have any arb deals done yet.
Your on the right trac. I just can’t confirm as we are announcing at 8pm.
Why Wilson? He’s your most durable reliever

Your still thinking with your heart.  No Quotes. McCann and Wilson have been serviceable players but have not garnered absolutely no trade interest from other clubs in the last two years. That does not mean a club won’t sign them on the FA market but they won’t give up even a Fringe prospect for them. So we have to move on save the money and invest in other areas even if it means another tough year. It’s only the 2nd year of a full rebuild.

Greiner and Hicks with a couple of Vets behind them will be fine. The entire ML coaching staff as well as our ML scouts and Analysts all are on board at our meetings. Wilson also can be replaced for less dollars and hopefully someone that has better trade value
You could also use that spot on Rule 5 guy, which wouldn’t be as stressful on daily roster as Reyes was
